candidate.title: Admin addmembers can re-add existing user and raise RecordNotUnique, leaving partial membership updates
reports: [bug] addmembers calls group.add(user) with no existing-membership check before pushing into the users association. re-adding a user who is already a member — the natural case, since addmembers never clears the input and has no in-flight guard against double-clicks — raises activerecord::recordnotunique from the join-table insert and returns a 500, with usernames earlier in the comma list already inserted, leaving partially-applied membership and no indication to the admin.
